name: manage_main_bookings_schema_aware
description: Manages the main Airtable bookings table 'List' in base appTp5YgSp9DV2HYc using live schema awareness. Use it for auditing a booking, reading fields, suggesting editable fields, filtering bookings, updating fields safely, following linked records, and creating linked records when explicitly needed.

payload.operation: string (Required. One of: audit_record, list_updatable_fields, get_record_summary, get_field, suggest_actions, filter_records, update_fields, follow_links, create_linked_record.)
payload.booking_number: string (Optional but recommended for record-centric operations. Example: 123456test.)
payload.record_id: string (Optional alternative to booking_number for record-centric operations.)
payload.refresh_schema: boolean (Optional. If true, refresh Main/List metadata from Airtable before executing the operation.)
payload.field_names: array of strings (Optional. Used by get_field or follow_links to target specific field names such as 'Customer personal email' or 'Driver Name & Phone'.)
payload.fields: object (Optional. Used by update_fields. Provide Airtable field names mapped to desired values. The handler normalizes canonical field names and coerces select/link/attachment values by schema type.)
payload.filters: array of objects (Optional. Used by filter_records. Each item supports: field_name, operator [eq|contains|in|not_empty], value.)
payload.max_records: integer (Optional. Used by filter_records as the upstream Airtable fetch cap.)
payload.result_limit: integer (Optional. Used by filter_records to limit returned records in the action result.)
payload.link_field_name: string (Optional. Used by create_linked_record. Must be a multipleRecordLinks field from the List table.)
payload.linked_record_fields: object (Optional. Used by create_linked_record to create a record inside the linked table before attaching it to the source booking.)
